title: Multi-Codec Compression
subtitle: Compress, decompress, and identify zstd, gzip, brotli, lz4, snappy, xz, and bzip2 payloads stored in BLOB columns.
provenance: Actual catalog tags from the released runtime used by the notebook

runtime_export.query: SELECT database_name, comment, map_extract_value(tags,'vgi.title') AS title, map_extract_value(tags,'vgi.subtitle') AS subtitle FROM duckdb_databases() WHERE map_extract_value(tags,'vgi.title') IS NOT NULL
rows: Multi-codec (de)compression over a DuckDB `BLOB` column — zstd, gzip, zlib, deflate, brotli, lz4, snappy, xz, lzma, bzip2 — with codec auto-detection and a decompression-bomb guard.
